goal: Minimal direct editing: ordinary valid Action changes save automatically without routine Save/Review UI, while preserving local intent and transactional/recovery contracts.
authority: New user request rejects Save changes/Review changes and unnecessary Add explanation; delegated by root to native requirements verifier.

defaults_and_assumptions.statement: The authored design chooses a 500 ms trailing debounce for free text/number/date, with blur/navigation flush and injected scheduler. This is a reversible implementation default, not a user-approved timing threshold; intermediate typing coalesces.
defaults_and_assumptions.invalidation: If rapid typing causes write backlog or delayed feedback harms usability, adjust the bounded interval without weakening integrity.

defaults_and_assumptions.statement: Discrete valid controls may save immediately; free text coalesces. Partial date/order input remains local until fully valid. Routine changes do not open review.
defaults_and_assumptions.invalidation: Explicit validation/recovery remains exceptional and concise.

defaults_and_assumptions.statement: Touched-field baselines distinguish external overlap from unrelated owner revisions. Overlapping external changes pause that target for minimal inline Use my edits / Use saved. A definite unrelated revision conflict may refresh and retry once only when each touched saved field still equals its captured baseline or proposed value; unknown outcomes are never rebased or assigned a fresh ID.
defaults_and_assumptions.invalidation: If the target is missing or any touched field changed to a third value, no automatic retry: retain proposal and show explicit reconciliation. Bound one refresh/retry to prevent storms.

defaults_and_assumptions.statement: Pending/unknown writes do not prohibit local typing. Latest proposal versions queue by bound action ID/field; only one owner-wide mutation proceeds at a time.
defaults_and_assumptions.invalidation: Acknowledgments must discriminate submitted versions from newer local proposals.

defaults_and_assumptions.statement: No background retry storm or fresh-ID retry of an unknown operation. Explicit exact-request recovery uses existing receipt/replay semantics.
defaults_and_assumptions.invalidation: Definite rejected input requires correction or deliberate recovery trigger.

scenarios.given: A saved action is open with editable Title/Notes and secondary fields.
scenarios.when: Edit a valid value, pause, or leave the field.
then: The change saves directly after the debounced pause or blur through the ordinary shared mutation/revision path, without Save changes/Review changes controls or a routine confirmation dialog.

Compact Saving / Saved / Needs attention feedback appears only as needed and communicates actual acknowledged outcome. No routine Unsaved badges, long proposal text, saved-value comparisons or ID/revision diagnostics in primary UI; comparison appears only for reconciliation/failure.

Allowed Add contexts show one minimal control with no explanation/hint; only unavailable Add retains a concise necessary reason. Empty lists are one line. Default scope commentary is omitted; explicit nondefault filters and saved Perspective definitions remain visible to prevent hidden filtering. Authored copy remains English.
The action row reflects its retained draft Title immediately while typing, without fabricating saved state; raw user content remains unchanged.
scenarios.counterexample: User must click Save/Review, every keystroke writes, or a pending/failed change displays Saved.

scenarios.given: An autosave for value v1 is pending.
scenarios.when: Continue typing v2, including across navigation or response arrival.
then: Typing stays enabled and v2 remains visible locally. The v1 acknowledgment clears only the submitted proposal version/fields; it never replaces or acknowledges newer unsent v2.
After confirmed v1 and valid current revision, the latest queued v2 saves once; transient intermediate keystrokes are coalesced rather than serialized into a write backlog.
Owner-wide writes remain serialized, preserving current revision and exact request identity. Read/navigation/display remain usable.
Own confirmed v1 acknowledgment advances baselines for remaining newer v2 proposals to v1 before accepting the full snapshot; our earlier write is not misclassified as external conflict.
scenarios.counterexample: Busy disables typing, v1 response restores old text, v2 disappears, or concurrent writes create avoidable revision conflicts.

scenarios.given: A text field is in IME composition or a date/order input contains a partial invalid value.
scenarios.when: Pause, blur, switch action/view, or receive a host update during composition/incomplete input.
then: No intermediate IME composition value is saved; final composition text enters the normal debounce/blur flow exactly once.
Partial/invalid values remain local with minimal meaningful validation feedback; saved values remain unchanged. No invented dates or valid-looking coercion of incomplete input.
Action ID and field identity stay bound to the original edit event, so late composition/blur cannot update the newly selected action.
scenarios.counterexample: Composition pause saves half a word, an empty order becomes zero, or switching editor redirects a late blur to another action.

scenarios.given: Action A has dirty or queued changes; action B and another classification are available.
scenarios.when: Switch action, Project/Tag/Perspective, Back/Close or display width/mode before save settles.
then: A retains its bound proposal/timer/request; B displays its own state. Navigation does not implicitly discard A, retarget its write, or pretend A matches a different filter.
Queued/failed proposals have a named minimal re-entry path when their action leaves the view. All nine existing fields, notes raw text, caret/selection and meaningful focus remain available.
A pending created blank action still resolves by its returned generated ID and keeps its clean return route.
scenarios.counterexample: Current editorId is used by an old timer, hidden dirty proposal becomes unreachable, or navigation silently cancels autosave data.

scenarios.given: An autosave reached the server but its response is missing; newer typing exists locally.
scenarios.when: Wait for unknown outcome, check result or explicitly retry, while continuing edits/navigation.
then: Outcome remains unknown; the exact sent operation ID/method/arguments are retained. Result checking and identical retry are named and reachable without a blocking obsolete modal.
Newer typing remains local and queued, while conflicting writes and fresh retry IDs stay blocked until the original outcome is resolved.
Receipt/replay acknowledgment clears only the original submitted proposal; later saved corrections and unsent newer edits survive. not_observed never becomes a confirmed failure.
scenarios.counterexample: Automatic fresh-ID retry duplicates a mutation, unknown clears local input, receipt check marks newer typing Saved, or scheduled retries storm indefinitely.

scenarios.given: Another entry changes a touched action field after local first edit, or an unrelated owner-wide change increments revision.
scenarios.when: Receive a fresh snapshot before debounce dispatch, or resolve one definite revision rejection by refreshing the full snapshot.
then: Capture each touched persisted field baseline on first edit; Defer input variants compare saved defer_until. If latest saved differs from both baseline and proposal, retain both values and pause that target before a stale proposal can dispatch or rebase.

A concise exceptional inline reconciliation shows relevant saved/proposed values with Use my edits / Use saved. Use my edits deliberately rebases conflicted retained fields to the current full snapshot and schedules normal saving; Use saved discards only conflicted fields and retains unrelated proposals. No routine review modal.

Unrelated owner-wide revision changes do not become false same-field conflicts. After one definite revision rejection, one bounded refresh/retry is permitted only when touched baselines still equal latest saved values or intended proposal; a missing target or third-value overlap stops automatic saving.

Definite rejected requests and safe resumed mutations use ordinary new operation IDs at dispatch; an unknown original request always retains its exact ID/arguments until receipt/identical replay proves outcome. State equality alone is never unknown-request acknowledgment.
Navigation/refresh retains the reconciliation and unrelated edits. Own acknowledgment updates newer local baselines so earlier self-written values do not trigger external-conflict feedback.
scenarios.counterexample: Latest owner revision is used to silently overwrite a touched field that externally changed, conflict comparison treats our own v1 as external, Use saved erases unrelated drafts, safe unrelated revision loops indefinitely, or unknown retry gets a fresh ID.

scenarios.given: A save receives a validation, authentication, network or definite rejection.
scenarios.when: The user waits, navigates and continues editing.
then: The last saved state is intact, proposal remains local/reachable and the affected action shows minimal failure/unsaved feedback. No false Saved state.

Definite validation failures wait for corrected relevant input; authentication/other definite failures wait for meaningful recovery. The only automatic revision recovery is the bounded, baseline-proven unrelated case in AUTO-06; no repeated timer retry loop.
Unknown transport outcomes follow AUTO-05 rather than assuming failure; recovery attempts retain exact requests until known.
scenarios.counterexample: Failure deletes proposal, repeated timer writes identical rejected input, or every failed save produces modal/verbose global notifications.

scenarios.given: Secondary state controls such as Flag/status/parent/Due/Defer/completion/drop are available.
then: Routine mutations apply directly without a review screen. Pure validation, descendant completion/Defer effects, owner isolation, revision/receipt and Undo guarantees remain intact.
Dates use explicit timezone, Due and Defer stay distinct, original raw notes stay exact, and blank Action Title remains valid with Untitled display-only fallback.
Minimal Undo/recovery remains accessible for consequential direct changes; ambiguous/invalid input never causes an invented commitment or silent destructive correction.

Existing preview_change may run invisibly for validated/resolved payloads, then apply_change serially without user approval. Descendant cascade counts/warnings stay observable inline after the result with Undo; removing the modal does not erase consequential meaning.
scenarios.counterexample: Review removed by bypassing validation/CAS, parent completion becomes nonatomic, or autosave invents a date from partial input.

scenarios.given: The application is narrow/full, light/dark and operated with keyboard/touch/assistive technology.
scenarios.when: Edit, navigate, receive host updates and recover from one pending/unknown/conflict state.
then: Editing, Back/Close and recovery controls remain reachable with no horizontal overflow or hidden save dependency. Indicators expose actual state to assistive technology without announcing every keystroke.
Host notifications preserve local proposals and composition/caret; host display mode follows acknowledgment/capability rather than width.
Before unload, dirty/queued/pending/unknown/conflict state is recognized so unsaved work is not falsely treated as safely persisted.
scenarios.counterexample: A removed Save button leaves keyboard flow stranded, Saved is announced for queued text, or leaving the page silently loses unsent data.

required_real_browser: Type v1, hold response, type v2 and navigate A→B; return and release responses. Inspect actual text/focus/indicators and exact request sequence to prove no overwrite/retarget/backlog.
IME composition and incomplete date/order at narrow/full widths; timer advance and host notification cause no intermediate persistence. Final composition saves once.

Drop save response while continuing typing; navigate/Back and check/identical retry, proving same original request and newer local input survive. Separately inject touched-field external update before debounce and demonstrate Use my edits / Use saved; an unrelated owner revision allows at most one baseline-proven refresh/retry without a visible routine review.

Keyboard/touch/assistive labels and light/dark screenshots show no routine Save/Review controls, no allowed-Add explanation, one-line empty state, immediate row draft title, compact Saving/Saved/Needs attention feedback and reachable exceptional reconciliation/Undo/recovery.
gates: Pure scheduling/state decisions use injected clock/timer/effect ports, immutable proposal versions and no input mutation.
Application/real adapter tests verify CAS competition, identical replay, missing responses, later correction preservation, Undo and owner isolation.
Generated DOM tests cover all nine field groups, blank-title/raw-note editing, navigation ID binding and state indicators.
Required pnpm check/build and built-resource smoke; failures/skips/unexecuted checks reported honestly.
Actual ChatGPT Work/cache/auth/D1 acceptance remains distinct from local mock/browser proof.
scope_limits: No independent recommendation engine, background management workflow, catalog CRUD, deployment or data reset introduced.
User-requested ordinary direct mutation intentionally replaces routine preview UI; backend validation/revision/replay/Undo contracts remain.
Existing empty Action contextual Add policy and one-request contentful MCP creation remain separate preserved contracts.

execution.status: Acceptance reconciled with authored native autosave design; final implementation acceptance pending

adopted: 500 ms reversible debounce with blur/navigation flush and composition pause.
Touched-field baseline checks including before debounce dispatch; bounded one unrelated-revision refresh/retry permitted, never unknown fresh-ID retry.
Use my edits / Use saved resolves overlap minimally and preserves unrelated proposals.
Allowed Add hint hidden; one-line empty state; row draft Title updates immediately; no routine unsaved/proposal/comparison/diagnostic clutter.
preserved: Direct ordinary editing without Save/Review UI.
Newer typing during saving and immutable original unknown requests.
reconciliation.limitations: Backend remains unchanged in this design. No code, tests, host evidence or kernel acceptance established by this artifact update.
